full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff brought Title suit No. 370 of 1982 in the court of first Munsif, Noakhali against the opposite parties and others for the declaration of their right and title in the suit land described in the schedule of the plaint stating, inter alia, that they are the owners in possession of the suit land by way of settlement from the original zamindar upon executing a registered kabuliyat dated 24.11.1943 and since then, they have been owning and possessing the same on payment of taxes; that the wrong recording of Diara khatian in name of the three sets of defendants opposite parties in different khatians have not created any right, title, interest and possession in the suit land which cast a cloud on their title and hence the suit.
